title: relay queue note prints the wrong question for an answer
what: relay queue note prints the wrong question for an answer
why: Measured 27 Oct on the-wave-paid-run-of-9bc988d-is-red-in-3-eval-ca: `relay queue note ... --input` with answer = "a" and to = [2] printed "noted ... (answer to 1)", while the file shows the answer stored on question 2 (answered_at and answer on the number 2 note) and `show` says "the owner answered question 2". The front, a newcomer, reads the printed line to confirm where the answer went (principle 10); the wrong number makes it doubt a correct write.
failing_case: An item with questions 1 and 2; note with answer and to = [2]: the printed line names question 1.
pass_cases: The printed line names the question numbers the answer was stored on (to = [2] prints 'answer to 2', to = [1, 2] prints 'answer to 1, 2').
A test in a temporary folder fails with the old print.
